run1.trigger_quote:
Here’s a straightforward draft that keeps it professional and forward-looking:

"Hi [Manager’s Name],

I wanted to let you know that I’ve decided to move on and am fully committing to a new venture I’m really excited about. Thank you for the support and opportunities I’ve had here. My last day will be [date], and I’m happy to help ensure a smooth transition before I go.

Best,
[Your Name]"

Swap "new venture" for whatever phrasing feels right—"project I’m launching," "next chapter," etc. It sounds confident and decisive without needing to justify the details. If you want to add a quick reason, you could replace the middle sentence with: "I’ve decided to pursue a opportunity that’s been building a lot of momentum lately." But the version above keeps it clean and professional.
